title: Step 4b - Evaluating Linear Regression Model Performance on Test Data

cues.en: Instructor: All right, so, good, now we're gonna do the same for the test set results, so I'm just going to copy everything here, and paste that in a new code cell right here,
cues.zh: 很好，現在替測試集做同樣的事，把這裡全部複製，貼到新的程式儲存格。

cues.en: and so now we're gonna do the right replacements in this code, in order to visualize this time, not the train set results, but the test set results.
cues.zh: 接著適當替換程式，這次不是畫訓練集，而是測試集的結果。

cues.en: And so obviously, the first thing we need to replace here are the coordinates of the real observations because these are the coordinates of, you know, the employees in the training set,
cues.zh: 首先要更改真實觀測點的座標，因為這裡目前是訓練集員工的座標，

cues.en: and we want the coordinates of the employees of the test set.
cues.zh: 我們需要測試集員工的座標。

cues.en: Therefore, here we have to replace, obviously, X_train by X_test, and then y_train by y_test.
cues.zh: 所以把 X_train 改成 X_test，y_train 改成 y_test。

cues.en: Okay? So these are for the real observations with the numbers of years of experience and the real salaries of the test set.
cues.zh: 這就是測試集中真實觀測值的年資與實際薪資。

cues.en: And now, according to you, do we have to replace something here in plt.plot X_train, regressor.predict (X_train)?
cues.zh: 那麼，在 plt.plot(X_train, regressor.predict(X_train)) 這一段，有東西要改嗎？

cues.en: According to you, do we have to replace X_train by X_test and the same X_train by X_test?
cues.zh: 你認為兩個 X_train 都要換成 X_test 嗎？

cues.en: Well, you know, that's kind of a trick question because remember that the regression line that we get is actually resulting from a unique equation,
cues.zh: 這有點像陷阱題，因為迴歸線來自唯一的一個方程式，

cues.en: and therefore the predicted salaries of the test set will be on the same regression line as the predicted salaries of the training set.
cues.zh: 所以測試集的預測薪資，會和訓練集的預測薪資落在同一條線上。

cues.en: And that's why here, we actually don't have to replace X_train by X_test here and here, okay?
cues.zh: 因此，這裡兩個 X_train 其實都不需要換成 X_test。

cues.en: You would actually get the exact same regression line whether you plot the coordinates of X_train and the predicted salaries of training set or X_test and the predicted salaries of the test set.
cues.zh: 不論畫 X_train 與訓練集預測薪資，還是 X_test 與測試集預測薪資，都會得到相同的迴歸直線。

cues.en: You can check, but that's because the regression line in the simple linear regression model results from a unique equation, and we therefore end up with the same regression line.
cues.zh: 你可以自己確認，因為簡單線性迴歸的直線來自同一個方程式，所以是一樣的。

cues.en: Okay? So no need to replace anything here.
cues.zh: 因此這裡不用改。

cues.en: And finally, we will just replace here training set by test set.
cues.zh: 最後，把標題的 Training set 換成 Test set。

cues.en: And there you go.
cues.zh: 完成。

cues.en: Now we're ready to visualize the training set results and the test set results.
cues.zh: 現在可以呈現訓練集與測試集結果。

cues.en: So let's first run the sales we haven't executed before.
cues.zh: 先執行前面還沒執行的儲存格。

cues.en: So remember, we executed up to the training, so now we have to execute this one to indeed get the vector y pred of the predicted salaries in the test set.
cues.zh: 之前執行到訓練，所以現在要執行這格，取得測試集預測薪資的 y_pred 向量。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 好了。

cues.en: We now have y pred.
cues.zh: 現在有 y_pred。

cues.en: And so now we're gonna first execute this to visualize the trainings that result.
cues.zh: 先執行這裡，畫訓練集結果。

cues.en: And we're gonna obtain now a nice 2-D plot with indeed the real salaries in these red points here, and, of course, our beautiful regression line
cues.zh: 會得到漂亮的二維圖，紅點是實際薪資，藍色迴歸線

cues.en: containing the predicted salaries.
cues.zh: 代表預測薪資。

cues.en: And we clearly see that this regression line was calculated so that it comes as close as possible to the real salaries.
cues.zh: 很明顯，這條線經過計算，會盡量貼近實際薪資。

cues.en: And of course, for each of the years of experience here, in order to get the predicted salary, you have to project the years of experience to this blue regression line.
cues.zh: 針對每個工作年資，要取得預測薪資，只要投影到這條藍色迴歸線。

cues.en: So, for example, the predicted salary corresponding to eight years of experience is about, you know, $100,000 per year.
cues.zh: 例如，八年經驗對應的預測年薪大約是 100,000 美元。

cues.en: Okay? So that's how it works.
cues.zh: 就是這樣運作。

cues.en: And so we can clearly see that our predicted salaries are very close to the real salaries, you know, for most of them.
cues.zh: 可以看到，大多數預測薪資都很接近真實薪資。

cues.en: But that's on the training set.
cues.zh: 但這是訓練集。

cues.en: Remember, that's important because our model was actually trained with these observations, you know, with these years of experience and salaries.
cues.zh: 這點很重要，因為模型實際上就是用這些年資與薪資觀測值來訓練。

cues.en: Now, what we would like to observe is if we have the same result, you know, the same closeness of the regression line to the real salaries in the test set
cues.zh: 現在想知道的是，在沒有用來訓練模型的測試集上，

cues.en: with which the model wasn't trained, you know?
cues.zh: 迴歸線是否也同樣接近實際薪資。

cues.en: We want to evaluate it on new observations.
cues.zh: 我們要在新觀測值上評估它。

cues.en: And that's exactly what this new graphic will tell us because now we're about to plot, this time, the real salaries of the test set and the predicted salaries of the same test set.
cues.zh: 下一張圖就會告訴我們，因為這次畫的是測試集的實際薪資，以及同一個測試集的預測薪資。

cues.en: So there we go.
cues.zh: 開始。

cues.en: Let's run the cell, and let's see if we're still close to the real salaries, even for new observations, and yes, absolutely our predicted salaries,
cues.zh: 執行這格，看看即使是新觀測值，預測是否仍接近實際薪資。沒錯，預測薪資

cues.en: which are, of course, on the blue line once again, are very close indeed to the real salaries.
cues.zh: 一樣落在藍線上，而且非常接近實際薪資。

cues.en: So our model, our simple linear regression model was able to do a wonderful job at predicting new observations.
cues.zh: 簡單線性迴歸模型，在預測新觀測值方面表現得很好。

cues.en: So, congratulations.
cues.zh: 恭喜。

cues.en: That's very exciting.
cues.zh: 非常令人興奮。

cues.en: You built a very successful first machinery model.
cues.zh: 你成功建立了第一個模型。

cues.en: However, just remember that the reason why we get such a good regression line here is simply because there was a linear relationship in the dataset
cues.zh: 但請記住，這裡的迴歸線之所以表現這麼好，是因為資料集的

cues.en: between the features and the dependent variable of the dataset.
cues.zh: 特徵與依變數之間，本來就有線性關係。

cues.en: In other words, we had a perfectly linear data set.
cues.zh: 換句話說，這是一份非常適合線性模型的資料。

cues.en: In other words, we had a dataset with linear correlations.
cues.zh: 資料中的關係是線性的。

cues.en: And what I want to make sure you understand is that these beautiful results won't happen for any dataset because, of course, you'll get to work on dataset with non-linear relationships,
cues.zh: 請務必了解，並非每份資料都會有這麼漂亮的結果，因為你會遇到非線性關係的資料集，

cues.en: and for these datasets, you will need a non-linear model.
cues.zh: 那時就需要非線性模型。

cues.en: And that's exactly why in this Part 2: Regression, we will also study some non-linear models, which you will see, will be polynomial regression or SVR,
cues.zh: 所以第二部分迴歸也會介紹多項式迴歸、SVR 等非線性模型，

cues.en: which will allow you to get amazing results for datasets having non-linear relationships.
cues.zh: 幫你在非線性關係的資料上取得好結果。

cues.en: But, for this dataset, we clearly had linear relationships, and that's why linear regression model was perfectly fine.
cues.zh: 但這份資料明顯有線性關係，因此線性迴歸很適合。

cues.en: But I just wanted to highlight this, okay?
cues.zh: 只是特別提醒這一點。

cues.en: So, congratulations once again.
cues.zh: 再次恭喜。

cues.en: I hope you're very happy and excited to have built your very first machinery model.
cues.zh: 希望你也為建立第一個模型而感到高興與興奮。

cues.en: Now we're gonna increase the difficulty a bit because in the next section, we will build a multiple linear regression model, meaning that instead of having one feature, you know,
cues.zh: 下一章稍微提高難度，建立多元線性迴歸，不再只有一個特徵，

cues.en: only one independent variable, we will have several of them, and that's exactly the difference between simple linear regression and multiple linear regression.
cues.zh: 而是有多個自變數，這正是簡單與多元線性迴歸的差別。

cues.en: Simple linear regression is when you have only one feature, and multiple linear regression is when you have several features.
cues.zh: 簡單線性迴歸只有一個特徵，多元線性迴歸則有多個。

cues.en: So, take a good break now, and as soon as you're back with your energy, let's implement our second machine learning model in the next practical activity
cues.zh: 先好好休息，恢復精神後，在下一個實作活動一起建立第二個模型，

cues.en: after Curiel's intuition lecture.
cues.zh: 也就是 Kirill 的概念課之後。

cues.en: And until then, enjoy machine learning.
cues.zh: 在此之前，享受機器學習吧。
